name: 艾丹
src: 月银纪史诗/第六歌_九步冷泉.md:235
who: Aidan, a human hunter of the Nine Spears of the White Hill, thirty-four: about 185 cm, tall, slender and quick, an athlete's long frame. Long, glossy black hair in loose curls with a deep blue sheen, the lock on his left side left longest, falling past his jaw to hide a small dark-red mark at his temple, like one drop of wine on the skin; a thin cord the colour of wheat straw is braided into that lock (on the viewer's right when they face us). Deep ink-blue eyes with very long lashes that look as if they are apologising for something. A strikingly beautiful face, so handsome it is almost unfair, with fine lines at the corners of the eyes from fifteen years of wind and rain. Fair skin. A quiet, apologetic, gentle air; he moves lightly and keeps a half-whittled wooden fork in his belt.
build: 185 cm, slender and quick, long legs and a strong back and shoulders from the hunters' trials, light as a deer.
palette: black and deep ink blue, grey-green, copper and brass, wheat straw
casual: His hunting clothes: a worn-pale Nine Spears hunting shirt and close-fitting trousers with a belt, a grey-green cloak over his shoulders pinned at the collar, soft hide boots, a short sword at his waist. Across his back two spears cross: one with a red-copper head, one with a yellow-brass head (on the viewer's left and right when they face us, respectively). He stands relaxed, hands loose, a gentle, slightly apologetic look.
private: Resting at the fire: the cloak off, a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed wool shirt and plain trousers, soft boots, the black curls loose over his face. He holds a small piece of wood and a knife and whittles a fork, a quiet, sad look.
battle: Ready to leap: the grey-green cloak pinned back, the hunting shirt with leather bracers, tall laced boots. He grips the red-copper spear in his right hand and the brass spear in his left, both held low and forward in a crouch ready to spring, the short sword at his waist; a keen, steady look, the eyes open, the mouth closed.
formal: At the wedding feast of the Nine Spears: a clean grey-green wool hunting tunic with fitted sleeves, laced at the throat with a leather thong over a pale linen shirt, a polished leather belt, a grey-green cloak pinned at one shoulder with a copper brooch. The red-copper and brass spears cross on his back, the brass head catching a thin glimmer. He stands very straight, hands clasped in front, a gentle, a little shy smile.
art: A close portrait, the ink-blue eyes with long lashes looking straight at the viewer, shy and apologetic, the lips closed, the dark-red mark at the temple half hidden by the longest lock. Warm low firelight from the right and cool dark forest behind. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the pale curl of wood shavings. He wears the worn-pale hunting shirt and the grey-green cloak.

name: 格莱妮
src: 月银纪史诗/第六歌_九步冷泉.md:291
who: Gleni, a human woman, thirty-two, the youngest daughter of the High King of the White Hill, who has been on the run for fifteen years as an unwed bride: about 167 cm, lean and tough. Long wheat-coloured hair, the colour of wheat in evening sun, now worn in one loose braid tied at the end with a strip of faded white satin cut from her betrothal dress. Eyes of green shot through with gold, like forest water in the sun, almost too bright to look at straight. Proud, fine White Hill features, a light scatter of small freckles across the nose from the wind and sun. Fair skin. A sharp, listening, restless air; she always counts how many people are outside before she turns round.
build: 167 cm, a runner's lean frame, narrow shoulders, a slim waist and gently rounded hips, a D-cup, strong long legs.
palette: wheat gold and white, forest green with gold, patched cream, hunter's grey-green
casual: Her travelling clothes: a short robe cut down from a once-white dress, the hem long since trimmed off and patched over and over, belted at the waist, close-fitting trousers under it, a man's grey-green hunting cloak over her shoulders, a leather pouch of dried white poppy at her belt, rough grass sandals on her feet. She stands with her head slightly turned as if listening, one hand at the cloak's edge.
private: Resting between runs: the cloak off, a long-sleeved, high-collared patched cream wool tunic to the knees over plain trousers, thick stockings and the grass sandals, the braid over one shoulder. She holds a clay cup of water in both hands, a tired, soft look.
battle: Keeping watch against pursuers: the short patched robe cinched tight, the hunting cloak pinned back, leather bracers on her wrists. In her right hand she holds a small clay wine flask, her left hand cupped to her ear to catch far footsteps, the green-gold eyes narrowed, the mouth closed; she carries no blade.
battle_pose: 3) the listening outfit: poised and alert, the weight on the balls of the feet, the left hand cupped at the ear, the right hand holding a small clay flask close to the body, the head turned toward a far sound, a sharp, watchful look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the court of the White Hill: a long straight dress of fine white wool with long fitted sleeves and a plain round neckline, a pale gold woven belt, a light cloak pinned at one shoulder with a large bronze brooch that holds a faint spark of beast-core glow, soft shoes. The old satin strip is still tied at the end of her braid. She stands straight-backed with the hands folded in front and a composed look.
art: A portrait with the face large and a little tilted, the green-gold eyes looking straight at the viewer with an open, clear, restless brightness, a small closed-mouth smile, the long braid over her shoulder. Warm low sunset light from the left, rim-lighting the wheat hair. Foreground blur: drifting wheat chaff and a few white poppy petals. She wears the patched short robe and the grey-green cloak.

name: 凯兰
src: 月银纪史诗/第六歌_九步冷泉.md:348
who: Kailan, a human hunter of the Nine Spears, the fastest runner of the White Hill, who looks about nineteen though he is thirty-one and will look that way for ever: about 173 cm, slim and wiry, light on his feet; a boyish face and a bright, quick manner, though clearly a grown man. Messy honey-coloured short hair, a long thin braid hanging from the nape, amber eyes that crinkle shut when he smiles, a small old scar through the outer end of the left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when they face us), a flash of white teeth. Fair skin. A pair of soft shoes burnt through at the soles hangs from his belt, kept though he wears new ones. Talkative, warm, quick, always looking toward the wind first and then at people's feet.
build: 173 cm, slim and wiry, a runner's long calves and narrow shoulders.
palette: honey gold, amber, hunter's grey-green, deerskin brown, soot grey
casual: His hunting dress: a short Nine Spears hunting shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbow, close-fitting trousers with deerskin leg wraps from the knee to the ankle, thin-soled new soft shoes; a single short spear on his back. Hanging from the belt on a cord, the old pair of soft shoes with burnt-out soles. He stands on the balls of his feet with a bright grin, one hand lifted as if to wave.
private: At ease on the road: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the collar open, plain trousers, the new shoes off beside him and the burnt shoes held up in one hand as he tells the story, an animated, laughing look.
battle: Running ahead of the danger: the hunting shirt cinched tight with a belt, deerskin leg wraps, leather bracers, the old burnt shoes tied at his belt. He holds his one short spear in his right hand pointed forward at a run, the left hand cupped beside his mouth to shout a warning, the honey hair and nape braid streaming, bright eyes and an open mouth.
battle_pose: 3) the running outfit: caught mid-stride in a full sprint on the toes, the short spear in the right hand held forward, the left hand cupped beside the mouth to shout, the braid streaming behind him, a fierce, urgent but still laughing look.
formal: At a village feast: a clean dark grey-green wool hunting tunic laced at the throat with a leather thong over a pale linen shirt, a wide belt from which the old burnt shoes still hang, the new shoes polished, a short cloak pinned with a bone clasp. A small bone charm cut with a wind rune swings at his belt, and a thin ember line still smolders in the scorched shoes. He stands with a cheerful, slightly embarrassed grin.
art: A close portrait from slightly low, the amber eyes crinkled in a warm laugh, the honey hair tousled by wind and the thin nape braid blowing across his shoulder. Warm low gold sun from the right, rim-lighting the hair. Foreground blur: flying ash and drifting sparks streaking past.

name: 埃奥甘
src: 月银纪史诗/第六歌_九步冷泉.md:584
who: Eogan, a human, High King of the White Hill, sixty-two: about 183 cm, tall and thin, with a stoop. Grey-white hair combed very neatly. His eyes are green shot through with gold, the same as his youngest daughter's, but clouded. Fair skin, thin and lined. On his head his grandfather's crown set with one glowing red core of fire, a size too big for his head. A proud, touchy, tired air; he is vain, holds grudges, and is softer-hearted than he would ever admit.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's face of sixty-two, thin and long, lines across the brow and from nose to mouth, loose skin at the cheeks; green-gold eyes slightly clouded, the lids heavy; thin grey-white eyebrows; a thin mouth set stiffly. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
palette: royal crimson and old gold, grey-white, iron, deep brown
casual: His king's everyday clothes: a long dark-brown wool robe to the shins with long fitted sleeves, belted, a heavy crimson wool cloak over his shoulders, soft boots, the crown with its glowing red core on his head, a gold ring on one hand. He stands stiffly, stooped, the hands folded in front.
private: Alone in his chamber: a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed wool robe to the ankles and soft slippers, no cloak and no crown, the grey-white hair still neatly combed. A tired, closed look.
battle: He is old and no longer fights; in the war-hall he wears a hide cuirass over his robe, a crimson cloak pinned back and the crown on his head, and leans on a long staff held upright in his right hand, the left hand on the hilt of a sheathed straight sword at his belt; a stern, stubborn look.
battle_pose: 3) the war-hall outfit: standing stiff and proud though stooped, the right hand leaning on an upright staff, the left hand resting on the hilt of the sheathed sword, a stubborn, stern look, the mouth closed.
formal: In state at the White Hill, as kings of the beast age dress: the whole pelt of the great beast of the White Hill that his forefathers slew draped over both shoulders with the maned head on the right shoulder, forepaws knotted across the chest and held by a big bronze pin, the fur giving off a slow ember glow. Under it a straight-cut long dark wool tunic with a wide leather belt and antler toggles. The grandfather's crown with its red core sits on his head, a staff tipped with carved antler in his right hand. He stands upright and rigid, a proud, stiff look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face slightly turned away and then back, the clouded green-gold eyes looking at the viewer with a stiff, proud, tired look that hides something softer, the lips pressed thin, the oversized crown with its red core glowing. Warm ember light from the crown on one side, cool dark stone behind. Foreground blur: drifting ash and a few red sparks.
